name: Biggus Dufus
vampire_desc: A germanic moron, desperate for a Pax Romanus.  Never got one...

marks.description: Pale skin, unkempt hair, long nails.

experiences: A germanic moron, desperate for a Pax Romanus.  Never got one...
Stillness, often overlooked.  Ignored and walked past by countless people.
Dogs are often beaten or attacked.  Dufus protects.  Bad people don't like being beaten.
Giovani often beats Dufus.  Trying to force him to feed.  Giovani is too strong and can't be resisted.  He's not a nice person.
He followed roman military units around.  He was often beaten.  One night he was beaten and bitten.  After that he was very ill, and avoided the sunlight ever since.

resources.name: Clothing
resources.description: Charity clothes and shoes arranged usually through the church.

resources.name: Good boots
resources.description: A particularly nice pair of boots

characters.name: Doggo
characters.description: A breed changing dog.  Easily confused.

characters.name: Giovani Punchinello
characters.description: Horrible man.  Wish he'd die.  Never does.

characters.name: The Dark Thing
characters.description: Dufus doesn't remember.  He was attacked in the night.  Sometimes it talks to him when he's alone.
